headline: Vance Boelter's 43 hours on the run
dek: Two Minnesota lawmakers were attacked in their homes in the early morning of June 14, 2025. Their attacker wasn't caught until 43 hours later. I teamed up with a reporter to visualize the largest manhunt in state history.

headline: What does the new WNBA CBA mean for the Lynx?
dek: After a contentious 16 months and a marathon week of closed-door negotiations, WNBA players and the league have a new collective bargaining agreement. I reported, wrote and charted what the salary increases in the CBA mean for the Lynx's 2026 roster.
alt: Animated gif showing 9 faceted bar charts, animating an increased 2026 salary over a 2025 salary

headline: In Lake Placid, Jessie Diggins’ swan song
dek: How does one visualize the career of America's greatest cross-country skier? I built a scrolly tracker, sized proportionally to the total (solo) kilometers Diggins has skied professionally, assembled with data from her FIS page. The 4,000+ km she skied doesn't mean much without context, so we added little anchors to help orient a Minnesota audience in that distance. And, even though it's not about the medals – Diggins' words – she has a lot of them! As you scroll, you can see just how many she accumulated throughout her career.

headline: Lindsey Vonn's career in five mountains (and one hill)
dek: Lindsey Vonn is a dominant alpine skier – and a proud Minnesotan export. I designed this piece with a colleague to explore the mountains that defined her career in the leadup to her final (?) Olympics.

headline: From the Gridiron to the Met Gala
dek: They say you can spot Justin Jefferson's chains from the nosebleeds at US Bank stadium. While that isn't true (I tried), it is true that the wide receiver has style. I collaborated with my friend and Vikings reporter Emily Leiker to dissect some of Jefferson's most iconic outfits.

headline: How does ranked-choice voting work?
dek: Minneapolis municipal elections use ranked choice voting to select City Council, Park Board and mayor. To help explain how the process works to our audience, I wanted to take a look at the election results from 2017 – the last municipal election where there was a strong possibility of an incumbent being unseated.

headline: A guide to the 2025 Minneapolis city election
dek: I designed the guide for Minneapolis' 2025 municipal election, which presented answers to key questions from almost everyone running. My favorite part? The homemade navigable map component to help readers orient which ward/park district they were in.

headline: Every State Fair Grandstand performance, visualized
dek: The Minnesota State Fair books a concert lineup at their Grandstand each summer. I wanted to know what we could learn from that data – who gets booked, when and why? I broke the data down by genre, gender and by how "relevant" an artist is.

dek: A mini hall of fame for the best Minnesotan high school athletes of the past 25 years

headline: Knee-high by Fourth of July: What grows in Minnesota and why
dek: There are 19.2 million acres of cropland in this state, and most of that cropland is devoted to corn and soybean. But how did Minnesota become such a corn and soy heavy state? I found out by getting friendly with the USDA CDL and the charting library Layercake.
